selectedMission.title: Operator-facing audit coverage and uncertainty review
selectedMission.rationale: The engine and report already exposed all 16 rules' scope, applicability, abstention, and safe ambiguous/unmatched comparison semantics, but the UI reduced this to a rules-executed count and an unfiltered comparison list. Exposing existing truth was higher-value and lower-risk than adding another rule without a validated applicability contract.
nonScope: audit, import, comparison, report, persistence, or download semantics
new heuristics, rules, scores, or auto-remediation

launcherFriction.finding: The packaged WindowsApps Codex launcher was denied before planning began.
launcherFriction.recovery: The failed dispatch was fenced and the configured TSF safe-provider launcher completed the planner retry without source changes.
